title: Print mode is what lets a CI job finish
expected_outcome: claude -p processes the prompt, writes one JSON envelope to stdout and exits well inside the job timeout; no terminal is ever waited on.

t1.command: claude -p Nightly support triage check: read only stock/jobs.py and answer in… --model claude-opus-5-5 --output-format json --max-turns 5 --permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools Read Grep Glob
t1.result:
Yes, potentially: `sync` calls `api.get_stock(sku)` with no `try/except` (`stock/jobs.py:12`), so any exception for an unknown SKU would propagate and abort the whole job.
Whether it actually raises depends on `api.get_stock`, which I didn't read per your scope, though the inline comment says this caller wasn't updated in PR 418, so check that.

evaluation.criterion: the job exited on its own with a JSON envelope (session_id present)
it returned inside a CI-friendly time budget
learner can explain why timeouts, retries or 'please exit' instructions do not change the execution mode
